already-priced-in-gold: {count} premium tanks, which the store already prices in gold.
an-indicative-estimate-only-store: An indicative estimate only, and a floor rather than a figure: it counts the vehicles this account has taken into battle, because Wargaming publishes a record per vehicle and never a list of the garage, so a tank owned and never driven adds nothing here. Each one is priced on its own at this region’s store rates, then added up: gold costs less in bulk, but no single purchase covers a garage this size, so one bulk price would describe a garage nobody could actually buy. Store prices also move with Wargaming’s own bundles and offers, and reward tanks are left out because the shop never prices them: they reach a garage through Wargaming’s own events instead, auctions and paid Battle Pass tiers among others, at whatever it asks each time.
an-indicative-estimate-only-verified: This prices the garage as its owner’s own account reported it, vehicle by vehicle at this region’s store rates, then adds it up: gold costs less in bulk, but no single purchase covers a garage this size, so one bulk price would describe a garage nobody could actually buy. Store prices also move with Wargaming’s own bundles and offers, and reward tanks are left out because the shop never prices them: they reach a garage through Wargaming’s own events instead, auctions and paid Battle Pass tiers among others, at whatever it asks each time. A vehicle sold since the last check is still counted until the next one.
bought-with-credits: {count} tanks bought with credits, at the game’s rate of {rate} credits per gold.
cost-to-reach-the-same: Cost to reach the same garage through the in-game store
every-tank-and-what-it: Every tank, and what the store charges for it
researched-with-free-xp: {count} tanks researched with Free Experience, at the game’s rate of {rate} XP per gold.
the-real-money-cost-to-research: The real-money cost to research (Free Experience) and buy every tank on the account, premiums priced in gold.
